label_status: AI drafted; Vinh accepted Vietnamese summary; not independent expert or card-by-card human validation
ranking_source: frozen Q1 trace, hash bound through comparison inputs
AI_relevance_policy: complete or partial in public real source cards; internal/synthetic policies excluded; secondary corroboration remains partial retrieval relevance, never automatically answer sufficiency
recall_policy: Original anchor Recall@20 retained. AI Recall@20 unavailable until a complete accepted anchor inventory exists. No passage-group recall is substituted.

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile over queries; paired label deltas use identical query IDs

interpretation: Changes between original and AI labels measure sensitivity to labeling, not retrieval improvement. All rankings are unchanged. AI scope/authority decisions remain reviewable assumptions. No latency or security rate is remeasured.
